stories.title: Federal aviation investigators look into deadly Amazon cargo plane crash in Miami
stories.summary: Federal aviation investigators are searching for answers following a deadly cargo plane crash at Miami International Airport Sunday that killed five people and injured at least five others.

stories.title: The far-right AfD's victory in eastern Germany has sent a political signal to Berlin
stories.summary: A landslide victory for the far-right AfD in a tiny German region sends seismic political tremors far beyond its borders.

stories.title: Countertop workers with silicosis struggle to get benefits meant to help them
stories.summary: Many California countertop workers diagnosed with silicosis from engineered stone are struggling to obtain workers' compensation benefits as insurers deny claims.

stories.title: A screenwriter claims her idea for what became the TV series 'Yellowstone' was stolen
stories.summary: A screenwriter is suing a major Hollywood television producer, alleging that her screenplay and ideas were stolen and used in the hit TV series Yellowstone.

stories.title: The copper peptide trend has gone from creams to injections — ahead of the science
stories.summary: Copper peptides are among the biggest viral trends on social media. Does evidence support smearing on the electric blue tincture for firmer skin, wound healing and other anti-aging effects?

stories.title: How a birthday trip to Africa — and the work of Octavia Butler — led to a picture book
stories.summary: A 50th birthday trip to Ghana and Senegal sparked a new picture book called That You Are Here is No Small Thing, which guides children through Black American history.
